description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki Samurai OEM Flexible Wire Clamps.
These are the Original Suzuki Rubber Coated Flex Clamps.
Bolt-On Design.
Bends to Any Shape Required.
Best Clamp Made for Holding Wires and Cables Securely in Place.
Doesn’t Damage Wire Sheathing.
Rubber Coating Reduces Movement and Doesn’t allow Friction Wear.
Comes with a Complete Set of Attachment Hardware.
26 Piece Set.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 5 – Flexible Wire Clamps – 3 1/4″ x 9/16″
Qty 5 – Flexible Wire Clamps – 3″ x 7/16″
Qty 3 – Flexible Wire Clamps – 4″ x 5/8″
Qty 10 – 5mm Attachment Screws
Qty 3 – 6mm Attachment Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
